capabilities: Index hidden dot-folders at every vault level
Toggle each hidden path's visibility in the file tree
Refresh the list of discovered hidden paths
extras: Must not run alongside Hidden Folders Access because both patch the same file adapter; desktop only; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Fork of Hidden Folders Access, which only lists root-level paths like .claude
problem: Obsidian only shows hidden folders at the vault root, so nested dot-folders such as agent skill directories are invisible in the file tree.

relations.evidence: Fork of Hidden Folders Access, which only lists root-level paths like .claude

summary: File-tree plugin that indexes nested dot-folders (like classes/.grok) at any vault level and lets you toggle each hidden path's visibility.
